# Tasks: Dude Canvas About

Apply **Classic Settings About**, approved by direct chat at 2026-09-26T01:11:26Z and bound in `spec.md` to `.dude/specs/074-dude-canvas-about/design/about.html`, SHA256 `46c7e0d7c96885b19c4bd5453fe7cf8b81968d7f2ceb36ae262a6addbc91df9e`.

All three units are new, sequential proposals with no inherited done evidence. State, dependency application, and closure remain coordinator-owned. Each executed unit receives one Tester and one independent Reviewer through ordinary Work. T001 proves the data boundary; T002 proves the rendered/local integration; only T003 requires the installed-host acceptance.

## Shared Boundaries

The Scope lists below include all intended repository writers, including Tester changes and generated deliverables. Declare those exact paths before each Work authorization; do not use directory-wide permission. Rebuild generated output through the existing scripts, never by hand. If the expected output or repair needs another path, stop for the existing scope owner before writing. Preserve unrelated dirty work.

Keep the approved primary, its 22 captures, all references, both design baselines, and feature 063 byte-unchanged. No design refinement, extra affordance, new dependency, dependency installation, or module beyond the two About modules already chosen in `plan.md`. Keep the source manifest, profile, Compose/upgrade APIs, theme, shell HTML, Review implementation/static notices, and workflow runtime unchanged.

Use the existing harness-owned OS temporary fixtures and evidence directories; do not put production acceptance captures into the approved mock set. On Windows, select the verified installed Edge executable with `DUDE_CANVAS_BROWSER`, set `$env:DUDE_CANVAS_BROWSER_REQUIRED = '1'`, and use Node 22+ with global WebSocket for CDP. Record actual executed/failed/skipped counts and evidence paths. A skipped or zero-match selected check is not coverage. Keep all check results within ordinary Work's existing bounded contract; do not split assertions/screenshots into a new attestation scheme or discard failures to fit.

Existing Windows failures may be isolated against current HEAD and reported separately with their affected obligations still unverified. Do not fix unrelated baselines, weaken tests, substitute a host, or report a false pass. Ordinary Work stop and recovery rules remain in force.

    Scope:
        - Authoritative writers: `src/extensions/dude/lib/about.mjs`, `src/extensions/dude/lib/canvas-server.mjs`, and `src/extensions/dude/canvas-server.test.mjs`. Put adapter and HTTP cases in this existing test file; add no separate harness or test module.
        - Generated writers: `.github/extensions/dude/lib/about.mjs` and `.github/extensions/dude/lib/canvas-server.mjs`, projected only by `node scripts/build-dev.mjs`. No frontend or asset changes in this unit.
    Trace: US1; FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-010, FR-012, FR-014; SC-001 and SC-004's read boundary; plan "Installation Data And Display Contract" and "Private Read API".
    Acceptance:
        1. Read only the bound workspace's fixed bundle manifest through the existing path resolver and regular-file check. Reject linked roots/components and non-files; decode valid UTF-8 and reuse the existing single-fenced-JSON parser. Do not acquire a catalog, call Compose/upgrade, inspect Git/host/environment versions, contact a remote, or write workspace state.
        2. Enforce the plan's closed manifest shape and nonblank `source_repo` provenance requirement without exposing that value. Validate each ref independently with the exact permitted-character/component rules; preserve accepted values without trimming, coercion, abbreviation, or channel-to-version fallback. Cover stable release/channel pairs, current `main/main`, `latest`, other/long/prerelease/hash-shaped refs, independently absent/empty/wrong-type refs, unsafe URLs/paths/control characters, `..`, `//`, dot-prefixed components, and components ending in `.` or `.lock`.
        3. Missing, malformed, multiple-fence, unsupported-key, invalid-provenance, bad-encoding, linked, non-file, and unreadable records yield the prescribed null refs, without raw document/error/path/credential/session/provider disclosure. Successful results contain exactly `installedRef` and `sourceRef`; all responses use existing no-store behavior.
        4. Admit only exact `GET /api/about`: GET bodies return 400; query/suffix/root override and other methods stay 404. Retain Host/Origin/fetch-metadata guards, including refusal of the opaque Review-origin exception here. Cover no bound root/ended lifetime (fixed 503), root replacement before delivery (409 while still live), and disposal so no old-root result leaks.
        5. Fixtures distinguish About's read from unrelated existing Canvas refreshes. Assert that the About path itself starts no command/process, network acquisition, or write, and that the generated backend is an exact source projection. No UI or installed-host acceptance is required for this prerequisite.

## Phase 2: Approved Settings Surface

Keep existing approved-design/reference and unchanged Review-module pins intact.
        - Documentation writer: `docs/commands.md`, limited to the Settings/About usage text.
        - Built writers: `src/extensions/dude/ui/assets/app.js` and, only if the build changes it, `src/extensions/dude/ui/assets/app.js.LEGAL.txt`.
        - Projected writers: `.github/extensions/dude/ui/assets/app.js` and, only if the build changes it, `.github/extensions/dude/ui/assets/app.js.LEGAL.txt`. Regenerate notices only from the existing pipeline; preserve notice content/coverage and source/generated parity.
    Trace: US1, US2, US3; FR-001–016's rendered/local behavior; SC-001, SC-002's standalone behavior, SC-003's local continuity, SC-004, and SC-005's rendered checks; VSC-001–005; plan "Chosen Structure", "Installation Data And Display Contract", and "Settings, Focus, And Continuity". Actual installed/embedded-host acceptance belongs to T003.
    Acceptance:
        1. Render the approved compact shared Settings heading, distinct Packs/About section tabs, and ruled About facts without changing the five-item rail or existing Packs body. Settings remains at the rail bottom and Canvas initially opens Overview. About hides Reload packs completely, supplies no replacement Refresh, and shows only the inert `About · Read only` footer. Packs restores its own controls and coverage.
        2. Show the plan's exact independent version/channel classifications for release, `main`, `latest`, other/prerelease/hash-shaped/long refs, and unavailable data. Render validated refs as inert text; transport/shape failures use fixed unavailable copy. During loading and failure, preserve Enrique Gonzalez, the literal official repository URL, and the recorded-provenance note. Never expose private/raw fields or imply byte verification.
        3. Add abortable `readAbout({ signal })` through the existing hook helper, outside refresh/polling and pack acquisition. Abort and ignore late results on local exit, root change, or unmount; each entry clears old values and makes one fresh read. Test combined hook/caller cancellation, delayed old-root/old-entry responses, malformed responses, and loading/failure navigation. About must not call `reloadPacks`, poll, retry in the background, or contact the repository merely by rendering.
        4. Keep Packs mounted across local switches. With unchanged data, retain context/filter/page/selection/results scroll; hidden detail/request dialogs must not cover About or remain in its focus/accessibility tree. Restore valid dialog presentation and existing focus rules on return. Ordinary re-entry resets Packs/Installed/All/page 1/no selection; the permission-return path explicitly chooses Packs and retains its request. Preserve selected work, finder query, task inspection, answer/New idea drafts, handoff authority, receipts, and retained Review state; do not change normal root/data reconciliation.
        5. The only About action beyond section navigation is the exact visible `https://github.com/E-G-C/dude` anchor with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Native pointer and keyboard activation in standalone Edge open a separate target and leave the Canvas URL and unsent work intact. No arbitrary URL opener, clipboard, host bridge, telemetry, or update behavior.
        6. Add focused `074 About:` cases in the existing browser suite. Using realistic records, capture light/dark at 180x450, 360x900, 768x900, and 1440x900 plus 200% reflow from the latter three sizes, not a second reduction below 180x450. Prove the two-activation route, nested-tab distinction, selected states/accessibility tree, Tab/Shift+Tab/arrows/Home/End/Enter, keyboard scrolling, visible focus, long-value wrapping, no horizontal overflow or clipped controls, loading/error transitions, and WCAG AA text/control contrast. Compare fresh rendered captures to the approved mock and preserved workspace composition; label the actual reflow method honestly.
        7. Rebuild before calculating runtime pins. Keep app/legal and static Review source/generated parity, the existing compressed-size budget, and all unrelated assets intact. The usage text describes Packs and read-only About without adding capabilities. Unit acceptance uses focused rendered/local evidence; the production-provider Pack/Review round trip and real installed receiver follow in T003.
    Check:
        - Build in order: `node scripts/dude-canvas-ui/build.mjs`, then `node scripts/build-dev.mjs`.
        - In required-Edge mode, run `node --test scripts/dude-canvas-ui/build.test.mjs`.
